consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance of the Grateful Dead at Fillmore East on September 17, 1970, was exceptional, particularly highlighting the acoustic set. Despite the poor sound quality of the recording, many reviewers praised standout songs like 'Box of Rain' and 'Dark Star' for their emotional depth and unique arrangements.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 36 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While the performance was highly praised, the consistently poor sound quality led to a more tempered overall sentiment.
